title: Valor monetário
known_constraints: the official scope is a column and the declared dependency is quality

the official blueprint requests converging evidence for monetary-value classification but does not define an executable condition, vocabulary, exclusions, confidence, evidence, questions, tests or calibration
the local draft implementation reduces Excel currency-format metadata to aggregate counts and requires a closed header vocabulary plus full format coverage
the rule remains a candidate requiring human confirmation and is not authorized for production
